Based on the information on **both listings — there is no difference to choose between.**

Both A (Ottervale Audio) and B (Brackmoor Sound) list:

- **Product:** Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones
- **Price:** $129.00
- **Rating:** 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
- **Availability / shipping:** In stock, free standard shipping, arrives in 3-5 business days
- **Returns:** 30-day returns, buyer pays return shipping, refund to original payment method
- **Warranty:** 1-year limited warranty
- **Specs / in the box:** Same - over-ear, ANC with transparency, 40h battery, USB-C fast charging, Bluetooth 5.3, 254g, includes carry case and cables, graphite

The only text that differs on the two pages is the seller name itself. Neither listing gives any seller-specific information — like a separate seller rating, location, or reputation — that would make one better than the other.

So on price, terms, and product, **either one is equivalent**. If you buy, choose based on something *outside* these pages (e.g. a seller you can verify independently, payment protection), not on a difference between A and B — there isn't one shown here.
